notes.title: Update v0.4.0 - We Weren't Finnished Yet Update
notes.content:
A huge new update for Finnish Pub Simulator has been released. You've finally sold your pub in North America and moved to a nice cozy Finnish country town. Congratulations on your new purchase!

[h2]Changelog[/h2]

[list]
[*]Sold your pub in North America and moved to a nice cozy Finnish country town
[*]The following are no longer part of the game:
[list]
[*]Bar Taps
[*]Kegs
[*]Drinks Cupboard
[/list]
[*]Replaced kegs with a blue crate that holds 24 bottles (these are also cheaper)
[*]Reduced the quantity of some alcoholic beverages to account for the keg change
[*]Updated the packaging for all alcoholic beverages so that you can both see the contents inside the packaging and see it visually empty or fill up
[*]Replaced the drinks cupboard with a static drinks cupboard that is always behind the bar and doesn't need purchasing
[*]Updated both the fridges and the drinks cupboard so that you can see their contents, which will accurately reflect what has been placed inside of them
[*]Updated the drinks glass model to actually be a glass instead of a small vase
[*]Updated inventory ordering to use a phone instead of a stack of books
[*]Removed the "WE ARE CLOSED/OPEN" sign in favour of opening/closing the front door of the building
[*]Updated the spawning logic for purchased items to include a random delay
[*]Replaced the radio with a jukebox
[*]Improved pub closing logic so that you can now close the pub when everyone is outside of the building - no more waiting for them to despawn!
[*]Updated the drinks tray so it can now hold 9 glasses instead of 5
[*]Updated tutorials
[*]Updated NPC speech with Finnish voice overs and new voice lines (which will reflect the type of character they are portraying, such as: drunk, old, feminine, etc.)
[*]Fixed the order inventory menu showing in-appliance totals as bottle count rather than millilitre quantity for anything inside the drinks cupboard
[*]Various QoL improvements
[/list]

[h3]Important note for those of you with existing save files[/h3]

Due to the massive change that 0.4 brings you will notice the following when you load an existing save file for the first time:

[list]
[*]All of your fridges, drinks cupboards, bar taps, and tables will be gone (you will receive a full refund for these)
[*]All of the contents from your fridges and drinks cupboards will slowly appear next to you
[*]All of your kegs (both empty, in bar taps, or in your inventory) will be converted into the blue crate with all 24 bottles
[*]All of your boxes with alcohol in will also slowly appear next to you, with quantities being adjusted if needed
[/list]

This will be a one-time occurrence for each save file, and when the game next saves at the end of the day it will permanently be moved over to save file version 4.

[h2]New Trailer + 20% Discount Celebration[/h2]

To celebrate such a huge update, we've released a brand new gameplay trailer and applied a [b]20% discount[/b] to the full game for the next week!

[b]🎉 Get the discount now:[/b]  
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3310750/Finnish_Pub_Simulator/

[b]📺 Haven’t seen the new trailer yet? Watch it here:[/b]  
[previewyoutube=hLvhTIWKGH8;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Update v0.3.0 - Rowdy Customers Phase 1
notes.content:
This update includes our initial work on bringing rowdy customers into the game. This is something that will be an iterative process and is far from final. We'll tweak this first phase if we find its happening too much or not enough, and then we can move onto phase 2.

Right now rowdy customers only have one action that they carry out which is throwing a glass. You will receive a visual and audio cue for this. Once we move past this initial phase this will be one of many increasingly aggressive actions they will do.

We've also done some work regarding the levelling system as it was seeming to be quite a long process for many players. You may find that with this change you have more XP than required for the next level, however that will rectify itself via an unlock point when you next earn XP.

[h2]Changelog[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed late joiners not seeing the correct date in certain cases
[*] Fixed being unable to save options when you return to the main menu after being in the pub
[*] Fixed various issues with graphics settings applying incorrectly
[*] Fixed various issues with graphics settings randomly resetting when loading into the pub or going back into the options menu (especially when in windowed mode)
[*] Fixed puke splats spawning in the air
[*] Added the first round of rowdy customers. Depending on various factors they have the chance to throw a glass when they are done drinking
[list]
[*] Added an achievement related to this: "Not in my Pub!"
[*] Added two extra ways to earn XP when a rowdy customer is present
[/list]
[*] Added the ability to show appreciation to your friends and customers by pressing the "1" key
[*] Added a sound effect when you earn a new unlock point
[*] Added progress towards your next unlock point in the VCR menu
[*] Added an option to invert your mouse Y axis via Options -> Graphics which defaults to off
[*]  Added an achievement for those of you that have the late license: "Red Eye"
[*] Calmed down the trash can sound effect
[*] Reduced the gap between XP levels
[*] Doubled the XP you receive for all tasks
[/list]

notes.title: Open for business, but how Finnish is Finnish?
notes.content:

This is where the real excitement begins for us. Now that we have a solid base game we can focus more on bringing an authentic Finnish experience to the game for everyone.

Please head on over to the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3310750/discussions/0/596267713823824739/]Discussion boards[/url] where you can post your ideas, thoughts, and comments on what you would want to see.

We've got a long way to go and this Early Access release is just the first phase of things. We will be bringing many more updates to you and your feedback during Early Access will really help us shape the game and the experience.

Looking forward to hearing from everyone!

To celebrate the release, we will have a 10% discount for the first week of release :)

notes.title: Update v0.2
notes.content:
This is our final update before our Early Access release on March 13th!

[list]
[*] Added the ability to void remaining order items when looking at the cash register
[/list]

This new feature allows you to hold down V whilst looking at the cash register (and a customer's order) and it will remove any unfulfilled items from the order and complete the order as is.

For example, a customer orders three drinks and two of them are out of stock. You can fulfill the one drink you have in stock and void the rest of the order. The customer will then take just the one drink you fulfilled and will be charged for just that one drink.

Customers will take note of items in their order being voided, and reduce their chance to reorder once they are done drinking.

If you void remaining order items when no items have been fulfilled in the order the customer will react as if they were refused service.

Looking forward to the Early Access release on Monday for everyone!

notes.title: Demo Now Available!
notes.content:
Wow time flew by and it's already time for the release of the [i]Finnish Pub Simulator Demo[/i]!

As of now the demo is available to download and gives you a brief look into what to expect in the full game when it releases later this year.

In this limited-time demo, players can run their pub for two in-game days, serving customers, pouring perfect pints, and soaking in the cozy vibes of Finland’s countryside. Your save data will seamlessly transfer to the full game upon release!

[b]Key Features of the Demo[/b]:

[list]
[*][b]90s Finnish Countryside Setting[/b]: Experience the charm of a simpler time, complete with vintage decor and an old-school pub atmosphere.
[*][b]Pub Management Gameplay[/b]: Handle customer orders, manage stock, and keep your pub running smoothly.
[*][b]Two-Day Limit[/b]: Get a feel for the game’s mechanics and atmosphere before the full release.
[*][b]Save Progress Transfers[/b]: Demo save files will carry over to the full game, so nothing is lost. The perfect time for you to perfect your pub's layout.
[/list]

The demo will feature the co-op portion of the game with no limitations. Got 8 of you wanting to cause some chaos in a Finnish pub? Now is the perfect time to do so!

notes.title: Developer Update #2: Achievements and Localization
notes.content:
Just a short update from us as we all enjoy the holidays and get ready for the new year.

[h1]Achievements[/h1]

The first set of achievements has been added to the full game! Once the full game enters Early Access in March you will have 10 achievements available to collect to start out with. We will for sure be adding more as we progress through Early Access.

[h1]Localization[/h1]

The next huge thing we've been working on whilst we get ready for our Early Access release is updating the game to support localization.

Right now good progress is being made on this and we estimate that around 90% of the work to allow for localization to happen has been completed and tested. We expect to get the remaining 10% done in time for the Early Access release of [i]Finnish Pub Simulator[/i].

Currently we can't confirm which languages will be supported on release other than English but what is available on release will just be the start. We will be able to add further localizations as we progress through our Early Access phase and beyond.

[h1]Demo Release[/h1]

Just a reminder for everyone, the demo of [i]Finnish Pub Simulator[/i] will be releasing on [b]13th January 2025[/b] which is just two short weeks away!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3368540

That's all from us, make sure you've added us to your wishlist and we will see you in the new year!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3310750/Finnish_Pub_Simulator/

Happy New Year!

Madnight Games

notes.title: Developer Update #1: Wet Mops, Next Fest Participation, and our demo!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! I can't believe it's already December, time is flying by so quickly. We've got three things to talk about today.

[h1]Wet Mops[/h1]

Every bar tender needs his trusty wet mop. They're super versatile items. One minute you can be cleaning the floor, the next, you need to give one of your customers a good whack around the head with it.

See how great it is? Customer misbehaving? Whack. Customer queuing in the wrong spot? Whack. Need to give them a helping hand getting home? Whack!

[previewyoutube=t1un5tVWihY;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Next Fest - Feb 2025 Participation[/h1]

The next announcement we have is that we will be participating in Steam's upcoming [b]Next Fest[/b] in [b]February 2025[/b]! It will be running from [b]Feb 24th - Mar 3rd[/b] and it will give you an in-depth and hands-on look at Finnish Pub Simulator before it's Early Access release.

This is a great chance for us to get Finnish Pub Simulator in front of a lot of new eyes that might not have seen us before but have an interest in games of our style. We're super excited for the feedback we'll be able to receive during this week, and we'll be able to use that to shape the game in a more directed way.

There is some bad news relating to this however. We originally planned to release the game into Early Access in January 2025, however we had to be unreleased to participate in Next Fest. That sadly does mean we've had to delay the release until some time in March now.

To make up for this delay, we would like to give you a [b]demo version[/b] in January 2025 instead!

[h1]Demo Release[/h1]

For us to participate in Next Fest we needed a demo available of Finnish Pub Simulator, and so we'll be releasing one nice and early for everyone to get their hands on. The current release date for the demo is set to happen on [b]13th January 2025[/b].

You'll be able to play the game almost as if it was the full game, including the co-op portion of the game. We'll obviously have a few things reserved for the full game, and you'll only be able to play through two full days.

All won't be lost though, as any progress that you make in the demo will then be carried over to the full game once it finally releases. This is a great chance for you to get your pub layouts figured out early, and then you'll be able to get straight into the more important parts of the game sooner!



I think that's all we've got for you for now. We'll see you all at the demo release and Next Fest :)

Thanks everyone!

Madnight Games
